svg.title: titan-t2t trading path
svg.desc: Pipeline: feed, ingress ring, decode, L3 book, signal, egress ring, gateway. Full path 135 cycles per message on real data.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The measured trading path: one core, no allocation, no system call

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A feed-handler step fills the ingress ring and a gateway step drains the egress ring, both outside the timed region (dashed).

svg.text: timed region, PMU cycles per batch

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Real NASDAQ BX day, mean per message: 135 cycles, 32.3 ns for the full path; 127 cycles without the rings.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This is software path cost on data already in memory. It excludes the NIC, the network stack and the kernel,

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so it is not a wire-to-wire latency. A hand-off to another core costs about 40.5 ns one way on its own (ping-pong RTT/2).
